supersedes_boundary: Previous review R5 is resolved by actual profile=None audit filtering for UID0 or actor UID; R4 remains explicitly documented historical-profile diagnostic limitation.

findings.R5: Runtime::events first authorizes requested current profile Action::Audit; global profile=None events are visible only for root or matching actor UID. Ordinary Events/read remains profile-scoped. This exposes retained denial facts without leaking another nonroot actor global facts.
findings.R4: Guide explicitly requires unresolved profiles to remain until coordination; removing one preserves state but current RPC cannot query that removed profile. Root protected-journal diagnosis is stated, not represented as normal RPC visibility.
findings.S2: start/begin/attempt call preflight(true) before persistence/admission. persist preflight(false) occurs before spawning a store commit, so a predictable bound/schema rejection does not poison healthy recording. Existing owner cleanup facts retain full 2MiB limit; durable I/O failures still poison recording, preserving fail-closed behavior.
findings.recovery_no_live_owner: start_recovery filters out jobs present in Controls.jobs and recovered repeats the same guard before applying results. Same-epoch unconfirmed attempts whose actual worker returned may now be inspected. No elapsed time, PID death or fresh epoch resource count supplies a terminal proof. Matching schema, kind, complete correlation, stable device key, broker UID and received resource ID checks remain.
findings.zero_session_intent: On restart, non-Finished jobs whose retained sessions all have Verified/NotStarted may become Finished; empty set is intentional. Client begin_session is awaited before TLS IMPORT/helper prepare, Native export prepare begins and awaits a session before helper acquisition, Native incoming begins before stub, and Rust virtual/physical first obtain export contexts before backend/listener/grant. Removing old verified terminal sessions does not remove an unresolved session. Therefore a legitimately produced empty job has no possible unrecorded helper acquisition, and finishing the job does not assert any USB device was released.

capacity_argument.scope: Static conservative bound for states produced by the current fixed schema and admission sequence, not a benchmark or runtime failure-injection test. Future field additions require recalculating the reserve.
reasoning: All correlations/resource IDs are validated fixed 36-character UUIDs. Existing attempt kind/correlation is immutable; only null resource ID/proof gains bounded data without new admission.
New attempts, new sessions and new jobs require fresh 1MiB admission; after the last admitted operation their counts cannot grow without resetting that bound.
Principal/profile/device key and other strings are immutable after admission; no arbitrary error or payload string is added during close.
Each of the three counters may grow from one digit to a 20-digit u64; lifecycle/error/evidence/cleanup are finite enums. Other boolean fields do not add unbounded data.
Audit is capped at 1024 entries and all fields are typed IDs, bounded ASCII profile labels, finite enums or bounded integers. Charging the entire maximum ring again is conservative.
Requests do not grow during cleanup/recovery; pruning only reduces encoded size.

analysis_only_json_examples.implementation: Python JSON compact encoding of public fixed-field shapes, no service/product execution, no synthetic USB evidence
analysis_only_json_examples.placeholder_note: The same 36-character UUID placeholder is reused only to measure JSON field lengths; actual BrokerCorrelation::validate requires distinct values. Replacing these placeholders with distinct canonical UUIDs does not change any length. This was not a valid product fixture or a product execution.

field_assumptions.source: core/application.rs validates canonical 36-character UUIDs; store/model Attempt
field_assumptions.bound: Entire smallest example 227B; use conservative lower bound 200B for count.
null to quoted UUID adds 34B; null to largest proof name native_import_intent_released adds 26B; charge 64B total.
Each decimal u64 grows by at most 19B; total 57B. saturated false->true does not grow.
Finite enums and booleans. Alongside counter growth charge at most 150B per session. IDs, device key, role, principal/profile and existing attempt identities cannot grow.
Finite enums and boolean; charge at most 50B per job. Job/profile/operator/epoch identities do not change.
u64/u32, ASCII profile <=64, UUID <=36 and finite enums; max-field compact example 362B; charge 500B each for all 1024 entries, including JSON punctuation.
At most 19 additional decimal digits; charge 20B.

field_assumptions.bound: No new job/session/attempt without preflight(true); no new request record without admitted Start. No post-admission growth counted twice; pruning only removes data.
